tess: bringing up equinox-8b (llama->gemma fusion) on our int8 path. quality drops after dotted lists and when accents appear. any ideas?
ori: can you show a minimal fail case and which tokenizer/normalizer you used?
tess: short diff:```
# prompt: summarize bullet list
FP32: "Key findings: 1) throughput improved. 2) no regression in accuracy."
INT8: "Key findings: 1) throughput. 
Random product blurb about pricing."
```
mika: newline + bullets often trigger special-token heuristics in some tokenizers. did we load upstream tokenizers.json or our generic fallback? also check special_token ids (bos/eos/pad).
tess: used fallback. upstream specifies normalizer: "NFC" and "diacritic_combining": "preserve". our pipeline used NFKC and "diacritic_combining": "split".
ori: that will change token boundaries for accents like "é" vs "é" and shift kv cache. also check positional start: some converted checkpoints assume positions start at 1 when bos is implicit.
mika: quant hint: int8 amplifies small rotary/headscale mismatches. try enabling per-channel quant and a rotary_scale_tweak between 0.86-0.95. small multiplier often calms the resonance.
tess: tried per-channel + rotary_scale_tweak=0.9 and swapped to upstream tokenizer (NFC + preserve diacritics). reran eval.
eval-bot: baseline(fp32): rouge-l 0.46 | exact-match 0.84 | hallucination 0.06
int8(before): rouge-l 0.28 | exact-match 0.59 | hallucination 0.39
int8(after): rouge-l 0.45 | exact-match 0.82 | hallucination 0.08
ori: nice. can we add an automated onboarding delta check that compares tokenization of 100 synthetic bullet/diacritic examples and fails if token-level diffs > 4%? also add a tiny convert sanity: assert special_token ids match upstream.
mika: I'll draft a small test harness and a snippet for convert.py:```
# convert sanity snippet
up = load_tokenizer_upstream()
our = load_tokenizer_local()
assert up.special_ids == our.special_ids, "special token id mismatch"
# adjust rotary if flagged in config
if model_cfg.get('rotary_scale_hint'):
    scales *= model_cfg['rotary_scale_hint']
```
tess: opening PR with tests + doc note: prefer upstream tokenizer, check diacritic handling, special ids, and rotary_scale tuning. linking this thread and infra ticket #4112. thanks folks :clap:
